description: Plays a page timeline for its subtree: it starts the named timeline when shown, and optionally restarts it when it ends (ANI-002).

props.name: timeline
props.description: The name of a timeline of the page.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Start the timeline when the widget is shown.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Start the timeline again each time it ends.

slots.name: child
slots.description: The subtree the timeline's tracks move.
